description: Independent per-material cv PINN; 32-unit, 3-hidden-layer fields, 2-point cell quadrature. Up to 13 valid frames and 20 bins. Budgeted rerun: {"steps": 500, "lbfgs_iters": 16, "fit_steps": 0, "fit_lbfgs_iters": 0, "lr": 0.001, "phi_lr_mult": 1.0, "w": {"data": 0.01, "pde": 1.0, "vol": 1.0, "bc": 1.0}}. Includes forward solve, 850 Adam and 30 L-BFGS field-prefit steps, then a frozen-field correction.
c_derivative_target: adjacent differences of observed concentration bin means
v_derivative_target: adjacent differences of velocity reconstructed from observed concentration
